[[Basketball League of Serbia]] | team = Mega Basket | number = 17 | birth_date = {{birth date and age|2001|3|30|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Livno]], Bosnia and Herzegovina | nationality = Croatian / Bosnian | career_start = 2018 | years1 = 2018–present | team1 = [[KK Cedevita|Cedevita]]/[[KK Cedevita Olimpija|Cedevita Olimpija]] | years2 = 2019–2020 | team2 = → [[OKK Beograd]] | years3 = 2020–present | team3 = → [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Basket]] | highlights = * [[Krešimir Ćosić Cup|Croatian Cup]] winner (2019) * [[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2017) | medal_templates = }} '''Karlo Matković''' (born 30 March 2001) is a Croatian professional [[basketball]] player for the [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Basket]] of the [[ABA League]] and the [[Basketball League of Serbia]]. He represents the [[Croatia men's national basketball team|Croatia national team]] internationally, although he played for Bosnia and Herzegovina at youth level. == Early career == In 2017, Matković participated in the [[Jordan Brand Classic]] camp. In August 2018, he participated at the [[Basketball Without Borders]] Europe camp in [[Belgrade]], Serbia.{{cite web |title=Jokic, Vucevic Headline Basketball Without Borders Europe 2018 |url=http://global.nba.com/news/jokic-vucevic-headline-basketball-without-borders-europe-2018/ |website=global.nba.com |accessdate=2020-09-30}} == Professional career == During the [[2018–19 Premijer liga|2018–19 Croatian League]] season, Matković was promoted to the [[KK Cedevita|Cedevita]] senior team. In April 2019, he signed his first professional contract for Cedevita.{{cite web |title=Karlo Matković potpisao prvi profesionalni ugovor s Cedevitom |url=https://basketball.hr/vijesti/karlo-matkovic-potpisao-prvi-profesionalni-ugovor/8270 |website=basketball.hr |accessdate=30 September 2020}} In September 2019, he was loaned to [[OKK Beograd]] for the [[2019–20 Basketball League of Serbia|2019–20 Serbian League season]].{{cite web |title=Veliki talent hrvatske košarke odlazi u beogradski klub |url=https://www.germanijak.hr/vijesti/veliki-talent-hrvatske-kosarke-odlazi-u-beogradski-klub/64806 |website=germanijak.hr |accessdate=30 September 2020}}{{cite web |title=Karlo Matković novi igrač OKK Beograd |url=https://sportsport.ba/kosarka/karlo-matkovic-novi-igrac-okk-beograd/328860 |website=sportsport.ba |accessdate=30 September 2020}} In August 2020, he was loaned to [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Soccerbet]] for the [[2020–21 ABA League First Division|2020–21 ABA season]].{{cite web |title=Karlo Matković 17 Krilni centar/Centar |url=https://www.bcmegabasket.net/player/karlo-matkovic/ |website=bcmegabasket.net |accessdate=30 September 2020}} Following the 2020–21 season Matković declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]]. On July 19, 2021, he withdrew his name from consideration for the 2021 NBA draft.{{cite web |title=NBA announces 51 early entry candidates withdraw from 2021 Draft |url=https://www.nba.com/news/nba-announces-51-early-entry-candidates-withdraw-from-2021-draft |website=nba.com |access-date=21 July 2021}} In April 2022, Matković declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]].{{cite web |title=Četvorica hrvatskih košarkaša prijavila su se za NBA draft |url=https://www.index.hr/sport/clanak/cetvorica-hrvatskih-kosarkasa-prijavila-su-se-za-nba-draft/2359781.aspx |website=index.hr |access-date=28 April 2022}} == National team career == === Bosnia and Herzegovina === Matković was a member of the [[Bosnia and Herzegovina men's national under-18 and under-19 basketball team|Bosnia and Herzegovina under-18 team]] at the [[2018 FIBA U18 European Championship]] in [[Latvia]]. Over seven tournament games, he averaged 8.6 points, 6.3 rebounds and 2.1 assists per game.{{cite web |title=U18 BH 2018 - Karlo MATKOVIĆ |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2018/player/Karlo-Matkovi%C4%87 |website=fiba.basketball |accessdate=30 September 2020}} His team finished the last with a 0–7 record. === Croatia === In November 2021, Matković expressed his interest to represent [[Croatia men's national basketball team|Croatia]] internationally in the senior competitions, if called.{{cite web |title=Hrvat koji igra u Beogradu odigrao senzacionalnu utakmicu! Ima samo 20 godina i želi dres Hrvatske |url=https://sportske.jutarnji.hr/sn/kosarka/aba-liga/hrvat-koji-igra-u-beogradu-odigrao-senzacionalnu-utakmicu-ima-samo-20-godina-i-zeli-dres-hrvatske-15117467 |website=sportske.jutarnji.hr |access-date=10 November 2021}} He made his debut for Croatia in February 2022, in the [[2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification (Europe)#Qualifiers|2023 FIBA World Cup Qualifiers]] match against [[Sweden men's national basketball team|Sweden]].{{cite web |title=Nova bruka hrvatskih košarkaša: Damir Mulaomerović neuspješan na debiju |url=https://sportsport.ba/kosarka/hrvatska-poraz-svedska-damir-mulaomerovic/419586 |website=sportsport.ba |accessdate=1 March 2022|date=25 February 2022|language=Bosnian}} ==References== {{reflist}} == External links == * [https://www.aba-liga.com/player/3050/20/1/karlo-matkovic/ Karlo Matkovic] at aba-liga.com * [https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Karlo-Matkovic/Summary/118836 Karlo Matkovic] at [[realgm.com]] {{KK Mega Vizura current roster}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Matkovic, Karlo}} [[Category:2001 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:ABA League players]] [[Category:Basketball League of Serbia players]] [[Category:Bosnia and Herzegovina expatriate basketball people in Serbia]] [[Category:Bosnia and Herzegovina men's basketball players]] [[Category:Centers (basketball)]] [[Category:Croatian expatriate basketball people in Serbia]] [[Category:Croatian men's basketball players]] [[Category:Croats of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] [[Category:KK Cedevita players]] [[Category:KK Mega Basket players]] [[Category:OKK Beograd players]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Livno]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]]
